summary: Vinci Compass Investments Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing minutes of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held July 1, 2026. Shareholders passed ordinary resolutions approving fiscal 2025 financial statements and appointing Eugenio Garza y Garza as director. Quorum was 88.02% of shares. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, or management change—routine AGM results. This is a non-routine but non-special filing.
